unsupportedSections: Market-Based Scope 2 (Contractual RECs pending supplier certificates)

disclosures.disclosureName: Total Energy Consumption (Renewable vs Non-Renewable)
disclosures.description: Aggregated fuel (diesel, PNG, HFO) and electricity energy inputs in Gigajoules (GJ).

disclosures.disclosureName: Water Withdrawal, Consumption, and Effluent Discharge
disclosures.description: Surface, groundwater, and municipal water abstraction across facilities.

disclosures.disclosureName: Waste Generation & Hazardous Waste Sent to TSDF
disclosures.description: Form 10 hazardous waste manifests and incinerated oil/chemical sludge under CPCB.

disclosures.disclosureName: Gross Scope 1 Direct Greenhouse Gas Emissions
disclosures.description: Stationary combustion, diesel gen-sets, boiler fuel, and fugitive refrigerants.

disclosures.disclosureName: Gross Scope 2 Location-Based Indirect GHG Emissions
disclosures.description: Purchased high-tension grid electricity calculated with CEA Baseline Database v19.

disclosures.disclosureName: Scope 3 Other Indirect GHG Emissions (Material Categories)
disclosures.description: Value chain emissions across purchased steel, freight transport, waste, and flights.
disclosures.calculationSource: World Steel / GLEC Freight / ICAO Factors

disclosures.disclosureName: Scope 1 + Scope 2 GHG Emission Intensity
disclosures.description: Emissions per Rupee of turnover and per physical project output unit.
